title: A named primary-care site creates a public route beyond a shortage designation while booking and completed care remain unobserved
source_unit: HRSA primary-care HPSA and service-site records linked to Health Partners of Western Ohio patient-facing access pages
geography: Allen County and Lima, Ohio; North Lima Community Health Center

observations.period: September 19, 2026; named-site administrative and patient-facing access checkpoint

denominator.unit: named active North Lima Community Health Center site linked to one HRSA-designated primary-care shortage organization

shared_hrsa_organization_id.unit: organization identifier shared by the HPSA organization and named service site

listed_weekly_hours.unit: hours per week listed in the HRSA service-site record

service_route.value: Medical, oral-health, behavioral-health, pharmacy, social-services, and substance-use services are listed; appointment requests are directed to the location or a login-gated patient portal rather than the general email form

affordability_route.value: Organization-level insurance, sliding-fee, payment-plan, and new-patient policies are publicly described; the retained page also reports limited same-day appointments

usable_appointment_and_care.unit: missing site-specific open slot, reconciled phone route, wait time, patient booking, travel burden, completed care, continuity, and health outcome

observations.method: Crosswalk of the HRSA HPSA organization row and service-site row through shared organization ID, followed by bounded extraction from official Health Partners of Western Ohio patient-facing pages. Nominal site hours and provider policies are kept separate from patient utilization.
observations.uncertainty: The HRSA site record lists nominal hours but not a service-specific calendar; the provider page displays overlapping hour lines and lists a phone number different from the HRSA row. The portal is login-gated and exposes no public slots or wait times. Organization-level affordability and same-day statements do not establish site-specific availability or completed care.
observations.subgroup: Patients seeking primary, oral, behavioral, pharmacy, social, or substance-use services in Allen County and surrounding Lima; no patient-level need, insurance, disability, language, transportation, or appointment subgroup is observed.
observations.counterinterpretation: An active site with listed hours, a phone/portal route, affordability policies, and limited same-day appointments may provide usable care for many patients; the public administrative surface cannot test that possibility at the person level.

related_sources.claim: HRSA primary-care HPSA records identify the designated organization and shortage context.
The provider contact page directs appointment requests to the location or patient portal and states that the general email form does not schedule appointments.
The provider medical page describes new-patient, insurance, sliding-fee, payment-plan, and limited same-day policies at the organization level.

boundary: This record follows a named Ohio primary-care route from shortage designation to shared-organization identity, active service site, nominal hours, patient-facing contact, and affordability policy. It does not estimate usable access, appointment completion, wait, care continuity, health, work, household time or money, trust, switching, or exit.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: Official HPWO North Lima HTML, compact event ledger, and named-site HRSA crosswalk were directly retained or hashed on 2026-10-20; the HRSA administrative source remains a public file-derived linkage.
